About SpaceKaur.

SpaceKaur is building autonomous systems for space and aerospace applications.

We are incubated at IIT Madras, with a presence in India and the UK.

We develop physics based models and validate them against measured hardware data. Our work covers control systems, software, electronics and actuation.
